chars.HERO: HERO: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with one wide black stripe across the chest, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.MANAL: MANAL: a young woman wearing a fitted bright red satin blouse, black high-waisted trousers, a thick gold necklace and red high heels.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: On a seaside café terrace in El Jadida, Morocco, HERO kneels on one knee holding up an open ring box toward MANAL, who sits at the table and smiles slyly with a cunning side glance. Two people face each other in the middle of the picture.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a busy Moroccan street market, HERO walks happily beside MANAL with heart-eyes, while MANAL looks away from him with a sneaky calculating smirk.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan clothes shop, MANAL laughs and points at more dresses while HERO, overloaded with many shopping bags in both arms, looks tired but in love.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a modern Moroccan apartment living room with a sofa and low table with mint tea, HERO and MANAL sit together on the sofa watching TV, relaxed evening.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the same apartment living room, MANAL walks toward a bathroom door holding a towel, her smartphone left lying on the sofa cushion right next to HERO, who stares down at the phone with curious eyes.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: HERO sits on the sofa secretly holding a smartphone in both hands, glancing nervously over his shoulder toward a closed bathroom door with steam under it, in a Moroccan apartment living room. The phone screen is a blank glow.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Medium shot: HERO on the sofa in the living room hunched over the glowing smartphone, sweat drops on his head, tense and focused, scrolling with his thumb. The phone screen is a blank glow.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: HERO on the sofa freezes with wide shocked eyes and an open mouth, holding the glowing smartphone away from himself, in the living room. The phone screen is a blank glow.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: HERO in the foreground on the sofa looks at the glowing smartphone in total shock, jaw dropped, while in the background MANAL steps out of the bathroom door wrapped in a towel, unaware and smiling. The phone screen is a blank glow.
